fields.name: VariantId
fields.description: Sellable variant this line refers to.

fields.name: Sku
fields.description: SKU snapshot at the time the line was added.

fields.name: NameSnapshot
fields.description: Product/variant display name snapshot, so the cart still reads correctly if the catalog changes later.

fields.name: Slug
fields.description: Product slug snapshot, so a cart line synced from another device can still link to the product page.

fields.name: ImageUrl
fields.description: Thumbnail image URL snapshot, so a cart line synced from another device can still render an image.

fields.name: UnitPrice
fields.description: Snapshot of the variant's unit price when this line was added or last revalidated.

fields.name: Quantity
fields.description: Quantity of this variant in the cart.
